muxt list-template-calls

flags:
--format
  shorthand: ""
  type: string
  default: "text"
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "output format (text or json)"
--match
  shorthand: ""
  type: stringArray
  default: "[]"
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "filter by template name (can specify multiple regular expressions)"
--templates-variable
  shorthand: ""
  type: string
  default: ""
  hidden: true
  deprecated: "use --use-templates-variable instead"
  usage: "DEPRECATED: use --use-templates-variable instead. the name of the global variable with type *\"html/template\".Template in the working directory package."
--use-templates-variable
  shorthand: ""
  type: stringSlice
  default: "[templates]"
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "the name of the global variable with type *\"html/template\".Template in the working directory package."
--verbose
  shorthand: "v"
  type: bool
  default: "false"
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "verbose log output"

--help:
Lists, for each template, the `{{template}}` actions it makes.

Full reference: muxt documentation docs/reference/commands/list-template-calls.md

Usage:
  muxt list-template-calls [package-dir] [flags]

Aliases:
  list-template-calls, calls

Flags:
      --format string                    output format (text or json) (default "text")
  -h, --help                             help for list-template-calls
      --match stringArray                filter by template name (can specify multiple regular expressions)
      --use-templates-variable strings   the name of the global variable with type *"html/template".Template in the working directory package. (default [templates])
  -v, --verbose                          verbose log output

Global Flags:
  -C, --change-directory string   change the working directory
